entities.name: Translation initiation factor IF-2
observations: 768-aa sequence matches reviewed UniProt A0LHL8 at 100% identity across the query; the reference is annotated as bacterial IF-2.
Homology-based annotation: promotes initiator fMet-tRNA binding to the 30S subunit and GTP hydrolysis during 70S initiation-complex formation.
Sequence-derived properties: estimated mass 84.7 kDa, pI 5.53; Pfam hits include GTP_EFTU (460–615) and IF-2-associated domains.
